name: komorebi
summary: Tiling window manager for Windows 10 and 11 driven by the komorebic CLI and a komorebi.json file. Named layouts (BSP, VerticalStack, Rows, Grid and more) per workspace, colored borders per container state, window rules, and a hot-reloaded config. Keyboard shortcuts come from a separate daemon (whkd or AutoHotkey).

install.notes: Install the hotkey daemon separately: winget install LGUG2Z.whkd
Needs the extras bucket (scoop bucket add extras); also scoop install whkd

windows.notes: License: the Komorebi License forbids any commercial use, which includes using it at work, without a paid Individual Commercial Use License; free for personal use. No built-in hotkeys: install whkd (or AutoHotkey). The status bar is optional and separate (komorebi-bar, started with --bar). Borders are drawn by komorebi as an overlay, and the author calls the feature a hack; they only appear on windows komorebi manages. Some apps need entries from the community applications.json (komorebic fetch-asc). Elevated (admin/UAC) windows cannot be managed by a non-elevated process (general Windows limit, not stated in the komorebi docs). Config files default to the home folder; KOMOREBI_CONFIG_HOME relocates them. Latest release v0.1.41 (2026-05-03). Enabling long paths and turning off unnecessary Windows animations is recommended by the install docs.

window-rules.notes: Float, ignore, force-manage and workspace rules match by exe, class, title or path. No per-window size or position rule; floating windows can only be centered and resized by an aspect ratio.

keybindings.notes: komorebi itself binds no keys: they come from whkd (recommended) or AutoHotkey calling komorebic.
